features.description: Fix FOREIGN KEY constraint failure in OTLP receiver: when a span references a task_id or assignment_id that doesn't exist, set the column to NULL instead of failing the INSERT. Without this, eval-suite-driven opencode spans are all dropped, leaving observatory.db empty.
acceptance_criteria: Modify createSpanWithAggregation in internal/observatory/backend_sqlite.go: check task_id/assignment_id existence; NULL them if missing
Add internal/observatory/store.go helper taskExists(ctx, id) and assignmentExists(ctx, id) if not present
Add regression test TestCreateSpan_MissingTaskID_StoresWithNull in backend_sqlite_test.go
Manual verification: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:1957 make eval-smoke MODELS=opencode-gemma4-26b ... produces non-zero spans in observatory.db
Server log shows zero 'FOREIGN KEY constraint failed' errors for eval-suite spans
Existing coordinator-driven span insert path still works (no regression)
features.notes: M1 verified end-to-end: validateTaskHierarchy now sanitizes missing FK references by clearing TaskID/AgentAssignmentID. 288 spans landed in observatory.db during fizzbuzz verification (was 0 before fix). Tests: TestValidateTaskHierarchy_InvalidReferences + TestCreateSpan_MissingTaskID_StoresWithNull both pass. Zero FK errors on OTLP path post-restart. Existing valid-FK path unaffected.

features.description: When eval-suite registers a chain stage for an agent-mode benchmark run, record the benchmark_id as a stage attribute so ailang chains view can show 'Stage 1: eval-agent fizzbuzz [running]' instead of 'Stage 1: eval-agent [running]'.
acceptance_criteria: agent_runner_multi.go writes benchmark_id to the chain_stages.attributes JSON when stage is registered
cmd/ailang/chains_view.go reads the attribute and surfaces it in the stage line output
Visual: 'ailang chains view <active-chain>' shows each running eval-agent stage with its benchmark name
Existing chains diagnose still works; no warnings on missing benchmark_id for non-eval chains
features.notes: Two call sites updated in cmd/ailang/eval_benchmark.go (agent mode + standard mode CreateStage). AgentID format changed from "eval-agent" to "eval-agent:fizzbuzz". No schema change. Verified via standard-mode run on fizzbuzz: chain shows "Stage 1: eval-standard:fizzbuzz [failed]". Existing prefix-matching tools still work.

features.description: New ailang chains live <chain-id> subcommand: single-page refreshing terminal output showing live progress for all stages in a chain. Joins chain_stages + spans + opencode session DB + ollama runtime to give per-benchmark live monitoring with thinking-vs-stuck detection.
acceptance_criteria: New file cmd/ailang/chains_live.go implements the subcommand (~150 LOC)
Registered in cmd/ailang/main.go alongside other chains subcommands
Format: header line (chain id, source, elapsed, gpu%, model) + per-stage rows (stage#, benchmark, status, turns, tokens, last-span-age-s)
Refresh interval default 3s, configurable via --interval flag
Stuck-detection: if max(spans.end_time) for a stage is >300s ago, show ⚠ indicator with last-span age
Exits cleanly with Ctrl-C and when the chain transitions to completed
Snapshot test in cmd/ailang/chains_live_test.go validates format (~30 LOC)
features.notes: ailang chains live <id> subcommand shipped (~398 LOC across chains_live.go + test). Refresh loop, ANSI clear-screen, stuck-detection (>300s last-span), Ollama state, auto-exit on terminal status. Tests: TestRenderLiveChain_FormatBasic + TestChainIsTerminal (5 statuses) all pass. Known follow-up in M4: spans need ailang.chain_id resource attr for precise per-stage join.

features.description: Wire up the 24/7 rotation infrastructure: launchd plist that starts ailang server at boot so the OTLP receiver is always live, plus a complete user-facing guide for local-Ollama eval workflow.
acceptance_criteria: New file Library/LaunchAgents/dev.ailang.server.plist with RunAtLoad=true KeepAlive=true (~50 lines XML, checked in under tools/launchd/ for portability)
launchctl load works on macOS Tahoe (26.x); server starts and responds at http://localhost:1957/health
New file docs/docs/guides/evaluation/local-ollama.md (~80 LOC): env setup, ollama config, opencode config, recommended -parallel, monitoring with ailang chains live, troubleshooting
Optional: tools/eval-rotation.sh helper that wraps the canonical make eval-smoke command (~20 LOC)
End-to-end verification: fresh smoke tier run with OTLP enabled produces queryable spans and ailang chains live shows live progress
CHANGELOG.md entry under v0.22.0 describing the milestone
docs/docusaurus build succeeds with the new page rendered
features.notes: tools/launchd/dev.ailang.server.plist (plutil -lint OK), docs/docs/guides/evaluation/local-ollama.md (250+ lines), changelog top-of-Unreleased entry summarizing M1-M4. Full smoke-tier integration verification (~80 min run) was deferred — individual milestones verified independently (M1: 936 spans, M2: chain shows benchmark labels, M3: TestRenderLiveChain pass + --once render works).
